ActivityRecordsCleared: {0} records were cleared from {1} by an administrator from the dashboard
AllowSystemAccessHelp: Runs the page unsandboxed with the same access as the web client. Only for pages you wrote.
AllowedUsersHelp: Everyone else is refused before any content is rendered. Administrators are not listed because they always have access.
AssetsIntro: Hosts images for your pages. Reference one by the path on its row, such as {0}.
AssetsVisibilityInfo: Images set to Anyone are public at {0}. Images set to User or Admin are only embedded into pages of the same or a higher visibility.
ConfirmClearStoreMany: Clear {0}? Its {1} records are deleted, and a configuration backup cannot bring them back.
ConfirmClearStoreOne: Clear {0}? Its {1} record is deleted, and a configuration backup cannot bring them back.
ConfirmClearStoreUnknown: Clear {0}? Every record is deleted, and a configuration backup cannot bring them back.
ConfirmDeleteAsset: Delete {0}? Pages that use it show a broken image.
ConfirmDeleteStore: Delete this store? Pages that call it stop working.
ConfirmDeleteStoreKept: Delete {0}? Its records stay on disk and return when a store with the same name is added.
DropImages: Drop images here or click to select.
EditOwnHelp: Lets a writer change and delete records they created when Scope is User records. Leave it off when records carry a status you write.
EmptyImages: No images yet. Add one above.
EmptyPages: No pages yet. Select New to add one.
EmptyRoutes: No routes yet. Add one below.
EmptyStores: No stores yet. Select New to add one.

ErrorAssetTier: Asset has an unknown visibility tier: {0}
ErrorAssetType: Asset content type must be a bare type/subtype such as image/png: {0}
ErrorConfigUnreadable: The configuration could not be read.
ErrorPageAllowList: Only a page served to signed in users can be restricted to specific users: {0}
ErrorPageTier: Page has an unknown visibility tier: {0}
ErrorPageUserId: Page has an invalid allowed user ID: {0}
ErrorRoutePassword: The saved password for route '{0}' on page '{1}' could not be carried over, because the route was renamed or now points to a different host. Enter the password again and save.
ErrorRouteUrl: Route {0} on page {1} needs an absolute http or https URL.
ErrorSaveBeforeClear: Save the store before clearing it.
ErrorSelectUser: Select at least one user, or set Access to All Users.
ErrorSlugTaken: Another page already uses that slug.
ErrorStoreLimit: Store record limit must be between 1 and {0}: {1}
ErrorStoreNameTaken: Another store already uses that name.
ErrorStoreReadTier: Store has an unknown read tier: {0}
ErrorStoreRetention: Store retention must be between 0 and {0} days: {1}
ErrorStoreScope: Store has an unknown read scope: {0}
ErrorStoreWriteTier: Store has an unknown write tier: {0}
HintCss: Styles that will be added to the final page using a <style> element.
HintHtml: HTML that will be combined with CSS and JS into a final page.
HintJs: JavaScript that will be added to the final page using a <script> element.
HintSingleFile: A complete HTML document served exactly as written.
MessageNotAuthorized: Your account does not have access to this page.
MessagePageMissing: This page is no longer available.
MessageSignInRequired: Sign in to your account to view this page.
NotifyHelp: Writes an activity log entry when records are added or removed. A burst of writes becomes one entry.
ReadHelp: Sets the lowest tier that may read the store. A viewer below it reads nothing.
RecordLimitHelp: Refuses writes past this count. A record holds at most 64 KB and a store at most 64 MB.
RetentionHelp: Removes records once they reach this age, counted from when each was created.
RoutesHelp: Optional server routes. {0} is forwarded to the target below, credentials included.
ScopeHelp: Sets how much of the store a reader sees. Administrators always see every record.
SingleFileHelp: Serves one complete HTML document instead of separate HTML, CSS, and JS.
StoresIntro: Keeps records that pages with Allow System Access write through {0} and {1}. Every page can share one store.
TaskRetentionDescription: Removes records that have passed the retention set on their store. Stores set to keep records permanently are left alone.
WarnAnonymousWrite: Anyone who can reach this server can add records without signing in. Only the record limit bounds them.
WarnScopeAllWrite: Everyone who can read and write this store can change and delete every record in it. Set Scope to User records to limit them to their own.
WriteHelp: Sets the lowest tier that may add a record. Changing a record needs the read tier too.
